llmJudge.intro: The Judge Model scores the user request (pre_call, during_call) or the LLM response (post_call) 0–100 against your criteria. If the weighted average falls below the threshold, it is blocked (or logged).

judgeModel.label: Judge Model
judgeModel.hint: The LLM that reads each response and grades it. Pick a capable model — it never sees end-user data beyond what the LLM returned.

threshold.label: Minimum Score to Pass
threshold.hint: 0–100. If the weighted average of criterion scores falls below this, the guardrail triggers. 80 is a good default.

onFailure.label: On Failure
onFailure.hint: Block: return HTTP 422 when the score is too low. Log: record the result but let the response through.

criteria.label: Evaluation Criteria
criteria.hint: Each criterion is something the judge checks. Weights must add up to 100%.
criteria.weightHint: How much this criterion counts toward the final score. All weights must add up to 100%.

thresholdsHelp.intro: Classify competitor intent by confidence (0–1). Higher confidence -> stronger intent.

thresholdsHelp.low: Low (≥): Log only; allow request. Below Low -> allow with no action
thresholdsHelp.outro: Raise thresholds to be more permissive; lower them to be stricter.
